summary: The Independent's timeline reviews Britney Spears' publicised relationships, from Justin Timberlake in 1998 to her divorce from Sam Asghari in 2023, ahead of the release of her memoir The Woman in Me on 24 October. It covers boyfriends, two marriages, engagements, breakups, and related controversies and statements, including her 13-year conservatorship that ended in November 2021.
one_line: A chronological rundown of Britney Spears' romances, marriages and breakups, from Justin Timberlake to Sam Asghari, timed to her memoir The Woman in Me.
key_facts: Britney Spears' memoir The Woman in Me is set for release on 24 October (2023) in the US and UK; the press release calls it "a brave and astonishingly moving story about freedom, fame, motherhood, survival, faith, and hope".
Spears' conservatorship, controlled by her father Jamie Spears, was dissolved in November 2021 after 13 years.
Spears dated Mickey Mouse Club co-star Justin Timberlake from 1998 to 2002; they broke up shortly after NSYNC released "Cry Me a River", whose video sparked rumours that she cheated.

Justin Timberlake apologised on Instagram after the 2021 Framing Britney documentary, saying he "benefited from a system that condones misogyny and racism", and backed Spears in June 2021 after her court testimony.

Spears married Jason Alexander in a Las Vegas wedding chapel in 2004 and annulled the marriage after only 55 hours; in 2022 he was arrested for trespassing, vandalism and battery after trying to crash her wedding to Sam Asghari.

Spears and Kevin Federline married in September 2004 after three months of dating; they have two sons, Sean Preston and Jayden James (born 2006), and she filed for divorce in November 2006 citing "irreconcilable differences".
In September 2018 Spears and Federline settled a child support dispute, with her payments rising from $20,000 to $35,000 a month after Federline had asked for $40k.
Spears dated British paparazzo Adnan Ghalib from 2007 to 2008; in 2009 Jamie Spears filed a restraining order against him lasting until 2012.
Spears was with agent Jason Trawick from 2009, engaged in December 2011, and called off the engagement in January 2013.
Spears dated David Lucado from 2013 to August 2014 and Charlie Ebersol from 2014 until June 2015, after eight months together.
Spears met Sam Asghari in 2016 on the music video set for "Slumber Party"; they went Instagram official in 2017 and married in June 2022 at her California home.
In April 2022 Spears announced a pregnancy with Asghari, and the following month said she had suffered a miscarriage.
Asghari filed for divorce in August 2023 citing "irreconcilable differences" and listing 28 July 2023 as the separation date, after only 14 months of marriage.
Asghari told TMZ on 13 October that he had read an early copy of the memoir and was "very proud of her".
